name: Rest Encounter
description: Random encounter table for rests (d100). The rest planner draws from it when an encounter check succeeds. The results get worse the higher the roll: the first entries are harmless or atmospheric, the last are grave threats. Many results are not fights at all. The text is only for the GM and is never shown to the players automatically. Edit, add or reweight entries as you like.

results.name: A quiet night with a strange sound
results.description: Something thumps or scrapes in the distance, once. Nothing follows. The watch is uneasy for no reason they can name.

results.name: A stray servo-skull
results.description: A damaged servo-skull drifts through the camp, mumbling half-erased prayers. Nobody claims it; its memory banks may hold a scrap of old data.

results.name: Flickering lights
results.description: The lumens flicker and die and come back. A tech-priest would call it a petulant machine spirit; to everyone else it is only unsettling.

results.name: A curious child
results.description: A grubby child watches the camp from the shadows and sells a rumour for a ration bar or a coin.

results.name: Rain, steam or a cold draught
results.description: Foul weather or a venting pipe makes the camp miserable. Sleep is poor but nobody is hurt.

results.name: A passing pedlar
results.description: A tired trader pushes a cart past and offers cheap goods, news and gossip. Prices are fair, or nearly.

results.name: Graffiti with a message
results.description: Fresh marks on a wall point to a hidden cache, a gang boundary or a warning. Reading them takes a little attention.

results.name: A friendly stranger
results.description: A lone traveller shares the fire, a story and a little useful information, and leaves before dawn. Honest, probably.

results.name: A lost animal
results.description: A hungry creature wanders into the camp. Feeding it makes a friend; chasing it away makes noise.

results.name: An old shrine in the ruin
results.description: The group notices a neglected shrine to the Emperor nearby. Prayer here steadies the nerves of the devout.

results.name: A distant hymn or procession
results.description: Voices, chanting and bells carry from far away: a pilgrimage or a funeral. Harmless, but it shows who is in the area.

results.name: Gossip over the vox
results.description: A vox picks up fragments of chatter from other groups: rumours, a name, a place worth remembering.

results.name: Vermin in the supplies
results.description: Rats, hive-roaches or worse chew through packs and spoil rations. A day of food is lost unless someone acts.

results.name: A petty thief
results.description: A sneak thief tries to lift a pouch or a trinket while the camp sleeps. Easy to catch if the watch is awake.

results.name: Lost pilgrims
results.description: A small group of frightened pilgrims asks for shelter and protection. They are slow, hungry and talkative.

results.name: Hungry refugees
results.description: A family with nowhere to go begs for food and a place by the fire. Their story hides something.

results.name: The authorities ask for papers
results.description: A patrol of enforcers or militia asks questions and wants to see papers. Social skill or a bribe keeps it short.

results.name: A drunk or stimm-addled wanderer
results.description: A wanderer rants, stumbles into the camp and may say something true. Or break something.

results.name: Equipment trouble
results.description: A lamp, a vox, a vehicle or a weapon fails at a bad moment. It can be repaired with time and a good test.

results.name: A rival asks for a toll
results.description: Locals claim this ground and want payment. They back down if the group looks dangerous or pays a modest price.

results.name: Smugglers on their own business
results.description: Smugglers moving goods want no witnesses. They bargain, bribe or threaten; their cargo is worth a closer look.

results.name: A wounded dog or servitor
results.description: A hurt animal or a broken servitor blocks the way. Helping costs time; ignoring it costs sleep.

results.name: Local troublemakers
results.description: A few bored youths throw stones, steal a boot and run. A nuisance, unless the group reacts badly.

results.name: A hard bargain
results.description: A local offers a safer place to rest for a price, or a guide for the next stretch. Cheap or a trap, it is hard to tell.

results.name: Disturbed sleep
results.description: Bad dreams afflict one of the group. Something sits on their mind; they do not rest well.

results.name: A wounded stranger with pursuers
results.description: A badly hurt stranger stumbles into the camp, followed a little later by the ones who did it. First Aid could save them.

results.name: Cult watchers
results.description: Followers of a forbidden cult observe from hiding and report to their masters. A trail leads to a hidden meeting place.

results.name: Theft or sabotage in the night
results.description: Ammunition, a vehicle part or a vox unit goes missing or is tampered with. Who had access?

results.name: A structural failure
results.description: A ceiling, a gantry or a floor gives way. Quick action avoids injury; gear may be buried.

results.name: Toxic leak or foul air
results.description: A pipe vents poison or the air turns bad. The group must move, wear protection or suffer.

results.name: The Mechanicus asks questions
results.description: Tech-priests or their agents ask pointed questions about the group's equipment and want to inspect it.

results.name: Plague carriers
results.description: A group of sick people drifts close. Contact risks infection, and the authorities will not be pleased.

results.name: A bounty hunter on the trail
results.description: A professional watches the group and waits for the best moment. Nothing happens tonight, but they know where the camp is.

results.name: A dream that is not a dream
results.description: A sleeper wakes with a vision or a whisper. It could be an omen, a trick of a psyker, or the warp.

results.name: Deserters
results.description: Armed deserters demand supplies and a way out of the area. Desperate and dangerous, but they may be talked down.

results.name: An informer among them
results.description: Someone the group trusts has been reporting on them. The signs appear tonight.

results.name: A fire in the next building
results.description: A fire starts nearby and spreads. The group must act, flee or let it burn. Smoke and noise draw attention.

results.name: An ambush at the weakest watch
results.description: A hostile group has tracked the characters and strikes where the watch is weakest. Surprise is likely.

results.name: A hive gang attacks
results.description: A gang that claims this ground wants a fight and a trophy. Numbers and mixed weapons.

results.name: Hunters from the dark
results.description: A large predator stalks the camp: a mutant beast, a xenos hunter or something from the sewers.

results.name: Mutant outbreak
results.description: Mutants or the afflicted pour out of the dark, driven by hunger or rage. Many weak enemies and a risk of contamination.

results.name: A would-be assassin
results.description: A killer targets one of the group. Poison in the water, a knife in the dark, a trap in the gear.

results.name: Rival agents
results.description: Agents of another power want the group's findings, or the group itself. They offer a deal and bring a threat.

results.name: A real warp disturbance
results.description: Dreams turn dark, animals panic, light and sound distort. A psyker feels the veil tear. Psychic phenomena are possible; the GM decides the effect.

results.name: Cultists at their rite
results.description: The group stumbles on, or is dragged into, a cult's ritual. The cult will not allow witnesses.

results.name: A large enemy force
results.description: A powerful enemy force enters the area. A straight fight cannot be won: escape, hiding or a bold plan are needed.

results.name: A horror in the dark
results.description: Something terrible hunts the camp. It cannot be met directly. Fear tests, shaken nerves and flight are likely.

results.name: A daemonic presence
results.description: The warp bleeds into the world here. A creature or a possessed host begins to emerge, and the dead and the living both behave strangely.

results.name: Betrayal
results.description: A trusted contact or an ally turns on the group at the worst time and brings others with them.

results.name: A catastrophe
results.description: A collapse, an explosion, a flood or a firestorm hits the area. Everyone must flee, and survival is not guaranteed.
